notes:
Fixes mouse interaction in the Custom Site Settings window by adding additional control and mouse-click handling while keeping keyboard and remote navigation unchanged.

Fixes Simple IPTV Update compatibility with Kodi 22 by replacing the invalid PVR add-on type query with PVR.GetClients for the active-client safety check.

Clarifies that Simple IPTV Update does not perform a full Kodi restart.

Improves Simple IPTV Prüfen by requiring real video playback before a channel is counted as started and by using a safer stop sequence to prevent Player/Demuxer race conditions between consecutive test channels.

Adds immediate resolver-failure signalling so permanently failed channels no longer wait for the full benchmark timeout.

Improves OXAX handling during the IPTV benchmark by positively preflighting candidate streams before handing them to Kodi and by closing playback error dialogs when a candidate fails.

Normal Custom Site playback, playlist generation, thumbnails, Landscape Wall support and update-check behavior remain otherwise unchanged from v1.91.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
